title: Exchange identities and symmetric slices of the valley Delta conjecture
summary: The valley Delta conjecture of Haglund, Remmel and Wilson predicts that the symmetric function $Δ'_{e_{n-k-1}} e_n$ equals a generating function over labelled Dyck paths with $k$ decorated contractible valleys. Unlike the rise version, which is now a theorem, the valley version remains open; indeed it is not even known that its combinatorial side is symmetric. We prove that the coefficients of $t^0$ and $t^1$ in the valley generating function are symmetric functions for all $n\ge 1$ and $k\ge 0$; equivalently, the fixed-diagonal-multiset slices of area at most one are symmetric.
